machine: 4-vCPU cloud container, CPython 3.13, single process; baseline and optimized run concurrently on separate cores
workload: PRIMARY_CONFIG (compact encoder) external-sampling MCCFR, seed 0, 300 warm-up + 600 timed iterations
optimizations: HoldemGame._replay and legal_actions memoized per game by action history (bounded tables, cleared at 262,144 entries)
abstract betting-context key memoized per game by action history
card features: flush-blocker helper replaces the full blocker scan (straight-blocker share was computed and discarded)
MCCFR sampling: inverse-CDF draw equal to Generator.choice(p=...) without its validation overhead

not_done.integer_infoset_ids_compact_arrays: not needed: locked config has ~41k-60k infosets at 1k-5k iterations, ~530 B each (~22 MB); the table is not a bottleneck in time or memory
not_done.compiled_backend: not built: after the Python changes the remaining time is spread over the hand evaluator, feature misses and the traversal itself; the Phase-29 budget (100k iterations x 3 seeds) fits in about an hour per seed on this machine, and a C++/Rust port of rules engine + features + encoder would carry semantic-equivalence risk with no need for it

equivalence.tests: tests/test_performance_equivalence.py pins pre-optimization digests for compact, bucket, transition and raw encoders; Kuhn/Leduc pins in tests/test_reproducibility.py unchanged
